proposal: Retail and logistics teams need AI and analytics that fit existing data and workflows—not disconnected demos. For OpenAI-based solutions, I’d validate data compatibility, access controls, expected scale, and evaluation needs before proposing a platform or production design; I would also define a practical monitoring and maintenance plan.
